title: Ricardo Gill — Magnetic sensing and physical information channels
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Exploratory engineering hypothesis; no Gill apparatus demonstrated

finder_profile.audience: Magnetic sensing and physical information channels researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Specify an actual carrier, safe encoding procedure, sensor calibration and blinded detection protocol. Separate physical signal detection from message decoding and creator attribution.
illustrative_example: A hypothetical encoded pattern is measured against blinded positive and negative cases. A text label alone does not constitute a magnetic signal.
evaluation_targets: False positives, missed detections, decoding accuracy, background robustness and replication.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.
